name: Keeping every part generic and measured
vision_statement: Every part of QAR stays specified as a solution with alternatives and a metric, so the best implementation runs as the state of the art moves and no vendor is built into the brain.
opportunities: A repository that specifies every part as a solution with alternatives and a metric lets the best implementation run as models and tools change. That is a space beyond the engine the top intent describes: the structure check and the selector belong to the esoi library, but QAR measures whether its assistant behaves by the structure, scores how much of its wiring is configuration and not code, keeps its tests runnable offline and its public code free of secrets, and loads one configuration per lane.
solution_coherence: keep-it-generic keeps every part specified as a solution with measured alternatives. It picks the arm that runs through select-an-implementation and finds what a change touches through tag-solutions. It measures whether the assistant acts by ESOI through behave-by-esoi and judge-esoi-behavior. It wires the selected arms per lane through configure-a-lane. It keeps the test suite and the public code trustworthy through verify-offline and keep-secrets-out, and scores how much of QAR's wiring is configuration through @hub-of-hubs/score-hub-connections.
